DOC-LEG-STAT-VOL-KE.title: APPLICATION FOR VOLUNTARY ADMISSION
DOC-LEG-STAT-VOL-KE.statuteLine: THE MENTAL HEALTH ACT 1989 (NO. 10 OF 1989, SECTION 10 (1))

explanatoryText.text: Every person who wants inpatient treatment signs this form to show that admission is at their own will or request.

noticeText.text: Any person received as a voluntary patient under this section may leave the mental hospital upon giving to the person in charge a seventy-two-hour notice in writing of his/her intention to leave.

noticePurpose.text: to avoid any misconception at later stages

noticeAcknowledgement.text: I have read, or had read to me, the Section 10(3) notice above.
noticeAcknowledgement.note: ASSUMPTION LGL-V-02: the acknowledgement checkbox is not on the paper form.

declaration.text: I {fullName} of {address} desire voluntarily to submit myself for treatment as an inpatient at {facilityName} and agree to conform to all existing and future rules and regulations for the conduct of the hospital.
declaration.note: Assembled from LGL-V-03 and LGL-V-04 as supplied; VERIFY punctuation and wording against the paper form.

DOC-LEG-STAT-INV-APP-KE.title: INVOLUNTARY ADMISSION FORM
DOC-LEG-STAT-INV-APP-KE.statuteLine: Republic Of Kenya Mental Health Act (Cap 248)

parts.A: Part A — Details of the Client
parts.B: Part B — Details of the Applicant

assertions.text: Incapable of making rational decisions regarding treatment

declaration.text: I, the undersigned, declare that the information provided above is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge and belief. I hereby apply for the involuntary admission of {clientName} (the above-named client) under the provisions of the Mental Health Act (Cap 248).

DOC-LEG-STAT-INV-REC-KE.title: RECOMMENDATION FOR INVOLUNTARY TREATMENT FORM
DOC-LEG-STAT-INV-REC-KE.statuteLineNote: VERIFY: the printed header line of this form was not supplied; nothing is rendered until it is.

declarations.text: I am a registered medical practitioner approved by the Medical Regulatory Body for the purpose of making recommendations under the Mental Health (Amendment) Act, 2022
I examined the said {clientName} on the {day} day of {month}, 20{yy}

grounds.text: the said {clientName} is suffering from a mental illness as defined under Section 2 of the Mental Health (Amendment) Act, 2022
the individual is incapable of expressing willingness or unwillingness to receive treatment as per Section 18
the individual is likely to benefit from involuntary admission as per Section 19

declarations.text: the said {clientName} is suffering from a mental illness (Section 2); is likely to benefit from involuntary admission (Section 19); is incapable of making informed decisions regarding their treatment (Section 18)
declarations.note: OQ-19: restates Declaration 3 with different Section 18 wording; both rendered as printed, never merged.

declarations.text: it is expedient for the recovery of the said {clientName} that {pronoun} should be received in a mental health facility for a period not exceeding six months, in accordance with the Mental Health Act
declarations.note: OQ-20: printed 'he/she' is replaced by the client's recorded pronoun, else 'they'.
